query: Patient is a 42-year-old man — among male ICU patients aged 37–47, what's the IQR of first recorded SpO2 on admission?
final_sql: SELECT (percentile_cont(0.75) within GROUP (ORDER BY result_value) - percentile_cont(0.25) within GROUP (ORDER BY result_value)) AS interquartile_range FROM patient_spo2;
